Package edu.secourse.patientportal.models

Class Appointment

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.models.Appointment
public class Appointment extends Object
Represents a scheduled appointment between a Patient and Doctor.

This class includes fields for identifying the appointment, tracking the participants, storing the scheduled date and time, and the appointment status. All setter methods perform basic null/validity checks and return boolean flags instead of throwing exceptions, to prevent runtime failure in the UI flow.
